headline: Priya Raman promoted to head of investments
detail: Trade press notice. She now signs rather than recommends, which changes who our counterpart is.
threshold_detail: Personnel news is noise unless it touches the person who decides. This one does.

headline: $6M recoverable grant announced to a competing neuro programme
detail: Second deployment this year in our field. Their budget is finite and we do not know its size.
threshold_detail: A grant inside our thesis, from a target whose budget we have not verified. Both halves matter.

headline: Life-sciences allocation raised from 8% to 12%
detail: Published in their annual report. Raises the ceiling on what they can do with us later.
threshold_detail: A stated allocation change from a primary document, not a comment in an interview.

headline: Michael Okonjo speaking at a neurotech conference in November
detail: Public agenda. A place to be in the room without spending an ask.
threshold_detail: Attendance only counts as a signal when it creates contact that does not cost connector goodwill.

headline: Form D filed for a new $400M vehicle
detail: They are raising as well as allocating. Relevant to the conserved-pool question on their budget.
threshold_detail: A filing that changes what an actor can commit, from a primary source.

headline: Quoted as "looking hard at neuro in 2027"
detail: One sentence in a podcast transcript. Consistent with her asking us to come back in November.
threshold_detail: Held deliberately: a low-confidence public statement is chatter. It is recorded so the threshold is visible, not so it is acted on.
